verdict.rationale: The official README documents both install scopes. Project scope is the default and installs to `./<agent>/skills/`, described as "Committed with your project, shared with team." Global scope uses the `-g` flag and installs to `~/<agent>/skills/`, described as "Available across all projects." A worked non-interactive example using `-g` confirms the flag in practice. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that both scopes behave as documented.
